title: Authentic final torsion binding
objective: Bind independently derived real-cubic torsion authority to the authentic live final-state field identity without oracle or answer-fixture inputs

oracles: Independent torsion authority recomputation and live final-state field identity replay

handoff.summary: Added a narrow final-result composer that takes only the neutral cubic polynomial and the live internal correspondence state, independently recomputes exact torsion, verifies the live field/authority/order/generator, and binds the result to the complete live-state digest. Detached replay recomposes rather than accepting an expected answer; the checker uses no PARI oracle or fixture inputs and rejects ten live-state plus two binding mutations.
risks: The adapter deliberately targets the current internal-correspondence-completion-v1 schema and totally real cubic authority; other signatures require their own roots-of-unity authority.
Repository-wide arithmetic/native suites are deferred to integration; focused syntax, Ruff, contract, replay, and mutation checks pass.
next_steps: Feed the authentic internal correspondence payload directly to compose_torsion_final_binding and retain the returned binding in the final immutable result without changing public-completion flags.
